texts.orig: NORTH DAKOTA CROP WEATHER REPORT, Week Ending August 21, 2011
texts.text: NORTH DAKOTA CROP WEATHER REPORT, Week Ending August 21, 2011

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Weather: Temperatures were below normal in parts of the west and northeast and near normal elsewhere. Precipitation was above normal across much of the southern part of the state and near to below normal elsewhere: Highs on Monday were in the 8Os to low 9Os with rain across the state. Severe thunderstorms with large hail and damaging winds were reported in parts of the southwest and south central on Monday. There were showers and thunderstorms in the east on Tuesday with highs in the 70s a few showers and thunderstorms in the central and east on Thursday with highs in the mid-80s to low 9Os. Highs on Friday were in the upper 6Os to mid-7Os with rain in the southwest. There were showers and thunderstorms in the south central and east on Saturday with highs in the 7Os to low 80s. Sunday was dry with highs in the mid-7Os to low 9Os
